content.text: {"posting_id":"8170920","verdict":"not_relevant","justification":[{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"title","evidence":"Title is \"Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer\"; it contains \"Senior\" and none of Software Engineer, AI Engineer, or Backend Engineer, so R1 fails."},{"resume_field":"job_search.work_country","posting_field":"location.name","evidence":"Location is \"Taipei,Taiwan\", which does not show the US, so R3 fails."},{"resume_field":"job_search.years_experience","posting_field":"content","evidence":"Content says \"8+ years of hands-on product design experience\"; the minimum of 8 is more than 3, so R4 fails."},{"resume_field":"skills","posting_field":"content","evidence":"None of Python, Java, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Spring Boot, React, Docker, or AWS appears as a whole word in the content, so R6 fails."},{"resume_field":"job_search.needs_sponsorship","posting_field":"content","evidence":"No phrase such as \"unable to sponsor\" or \"no sponsorship\" appears in the content, so R5 passes."},{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"first_published","evidence":"first_published is 2026-09-04, which is 53 days before the run date 2026-10-27, so R2 fails (updated_at is not used because first_published is present)."}]}
